information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/InlandEmpireSummer2022#18898-competitor-responsibilities) tab. For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out the [PNW website](https://www.pnwcubing.com)! Please be aware of Covid-19 precautions and read [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/InlandEmpireSummer2022#19138-covid-19-safety) before registering.
